title: Concept: Rate limit policy detail in a response
description: The configured limit and window for the caller in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A published limit tells an attacker exactly how much traffic is allowed before throttling, which is the budget for a scripted attempt.

risk: A published limit tells an attacker exactly how much traffic is allowed before throttling, which is the budget for a scripted attempt.
